outcome: Clinical presentation of tubal ectopic gestation
Risk factors for tubal ectopic gestation
cohort: 88 women diagnosed with tubal ectopic gestation at a tertiary care center over a three-year period.
finding: The most common risk factors for tubal ectopic gestation were pelvic inflammatory disease, previous caesarean section, previous pelvic surgeries, history of abortion, bilateral tubal ligation (recanalized), and infertility treatment.
